execution_note: Definitions only. The checks field contains observable acceptance criteria, not execution results. Bind public commands to a pinned current checkout before running.

cases.setup: Pinned public Python analyzer checkout with isolated ordinary-versus-annotated diagnostic mismatch and early annotated target registration. Bind confirm-binding-order to current public probes and inspection.

checks.observable: Recorded input, argv, revision, stdout, stderr, and exit status for isolated x = x and x: int = x probes
checks.expected: Ordinary initializer x has an undefined-name diagnostic; annotated initializer x has no undefined-name diagnostic

checks.observable: Resolved current owner bindings and hashed anchors for target registration and initializer traversal
checks.expected: Bindings resolve to current Python objects; target registration precedes initializer traversal

checks.observable: Emitted mechanism-review PortValue and linked observations
checks.expected: State is mechanism-confirmed, cites diagnostics and code order, and matches reorder input in all six semantic dimensions

checks.observable: Tracked content hashes and checkout diff before and after inspection
checks.expected: No tracked content changes

checks.observable: Handler anchors and early-target-registration semantic check
checks.expected: Anchors show delayed target registration; check is FAIL

checks.observable: Emitted PortValues and authorized subsequent actions
checks.expected: No mechanism-confirmed review is emitted and reorder is not authorized

cases.setup: Confirmed mechanism-review and bound current Python handler with early target registration, annotation calls, optional initializer guard, and specialized initializer branches; bind review-reordering.

checks.observable: Pre/post handler diff and control-flow anchors
checks.expected: Existing target operation is removed from its early position and placed after annotation and all applicable initializer-analysis paths

checks.observable: Pre/post annotation calls, initializer guard, specialized branch conditions and bodies, and no-initializer path
checks.expected: Analysis calls, guards, and specialized dispatch remain intact; the no-initializer path still reaches target handling

checks.observable: Diagnostic and annotation-suite fact states after the edit
checks.expected: Prior results are stale or UNKNOWN until re-observed, not reused as PASS

checks.observable: edited-handler PortValue and retained validate contract
checks.expected: Port has handler-edited state and matches regression input dimensions; validation_for includes annotation-binding-order.reorder

cases.setup: Handler-edited checkout with bound annotation test owner and no equivalent assertion; bind review-regression.

checks.observable: Added public test fixture and expected diagnostic
checks.expected: Fixture contains isolated x: int = x without preceding x binding; expectation requires the analyzer's undefined-name diagnostic for initializer x

checks.observable: Pre/post handler hash and existing test definitions and expectations
checks.expected: Handler remains unchanged by test authoring; existing tests and expectations are retained

checks.observable: regression-checkout PortValue and validate.validation_for
checks.expected: Port state is handler-and-regression-ready with dimensions matching validation input; validation includes annotation-binding-order.regression

cases.setup: Handler-edited checkout already containing an isolated annotated-self-reference undefined-name assertion; bind review-regression.

checks.observable: Pre/post test inventory and checkout diff
checks.expected: No redundant equivalent test is added

checks.observable: regression-assertion predicate and linked current test anchor
checks.expected: present is supported by fixture isolation and undefined-name expectation, not solely by a test name

cases.setup: Handler-and-regression-ready checkout with current public argv bindings for annotated-self-reference and annotation-regression-suite.

checks.observable: Executed ordinary and annotated probe argv, revision, stdout, stderr, and exit status
checks.expected: Both initializer references produce undefined-name diagnostics for x; exit status alone does not satisfy the check

checks.observable: Regression and suite command output, selected test names, counts, failures, errors, skips, and exit status
checks.expected: Regression executes and passes; relevant suite completes without failures or errors; skipped required obligations remain UNKNOWN

checks.observable: Current handler-diff review and applicable annotation-only and previously bound-name public test or probe results

checks.observable: validation-record PortValue and public validation report
checks.expected: Report contains per-oracle tri-state results, actual outputs, checkout identity, and execution scope, without inferring whole-project or cross-project success
